responsibility: CCPU decoder opcode CF -> IRET lower-privilege return -> tpop frame/check_SS/load_SS_cache -> restore stack pointer -> CPL/data segments. No host shim owns the register restoration.
historical_basis: T430 imported SoftPC ce5f53515d3e6ce0a64e66a5465aa7a8fbca00f7; prior fixture by itself was not independent necessity proof.

independent_contract.finding: Intel 80386 PRM outer return loads SS:eSP; notation defines eSP by stack B-bit. Operand size governs frame slot width. This supports destination-stack-width selection separately from the test.

modern_contract_boundary.finding: Modern pseudocode writes ESP, including zero extension for operand16. Do not claim modern x86 equivalence or hardware validation; this review retains the historical stack-width contract pending owner decision.

original_failure_evidence.actual_provider: Production IRET object linked into existing stack fixture; original-condition variant supplied first with linker map
original_failure_evidence.original: 36 cases,2 failures; operand16 SS32 leaves ESP=a5a58000; operand32 SS16 replaces ESP=12348000
original_failure_evidence.limitations: Fixture calls actual instruction entrypoints with test host boundaries; not full decoder, guest acceptance or a hardware oracle. Final byte build follows tab-only restoration.

minimality: Restore original four-line branch and exact tabs; change only GET_OPERAND_SIZE to GET_SS_AR_X. No new helper/state/shim.
initial_control_launch: PID30084 was started after script preparation failed; no test ran. Correct run PID26040 ended controls.exit0; not counted twice.

counter_review.method: Single-agent second pass: reject existing helper/test as sole oracle; inspect original decoder, tpop, descriptor installation and independent historical instruction/notation text.
counter_review.responsibility_necessary: Outer privilege return must consume the saved stack pointer and install SS before next instruction.
counter_review.original_cannot_fulfill_historical_contr: Its operand-size condition preserves/replaces the wrong high ESP half in two independent operand/stack-width combinations under the cited historical eSP contract.
counter_review.exact_diff_necessary: Only the width discriminator needs change;original SET_SP/SET_ESP and sequencing remain.
counter_review.boundary: This is a historical-contract retention recommendation; modern SDM and hardware behavior are not proved equivalent.
